comment_ja: 昨日は59勝43敗、損益は📉-5,400円。勝った割合は57.8%と過半数を超えたものの、オッズの低い賭けの取りこぼしが響いた。注目は町田対川崎で90分勝敗・ハンディ・両得点すべて的中し💰合計2,610円のプラスを稼いだ一方、福岡対浦和では4賭けが外れ損失が集中。累計は2,239件で勝った割合57.1%、戻ってきた割合-3.0%で推移。
comment_en: Yesterday went 59 wins and 43 losses, resulting in a net loss of 📉-5,400 yen. The win rate was 57.8%, above 50%, but missed bets on lower-odds markets weighed on returns. A highlight was the Machida vs Kawasaki match, where all six markets hit for a combined 💰+2,610 yen, while the Fukuoka vs Urawa match saw four losses concentrated in one game. The cumulative record stands at 2,239 bets with a 57.1% win rate and -3.0% return on stakes.
